item.title: Show HN: A daily covering-walk puzzle where mowing direction matters
item.summary: Every time I mow the lawn, I play this mental game in my head where I try and mow the lawn as efficiently as possible (while minding where I'm shooting the grass clippings). Well, I decided to turn this little mental puzzle, into a daily game. Enjoy! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49170296 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
